run_learner_speed_benchmark: run the max learner speed benchmark to measure steps per second for the Atari RL model
build_atari_model: build an Atari RL model with a given number of actions using models.get_model
compute_learner_loss: compute the reinforcement learning loss from learner outputs and batch data using learner.compute_loss
create_rmsprop_optimizer: create an RMSprop optimizer with configurable learning rate, momentum, and epsilon for model training
clip_gradient_norm: clip the gradient norm of model parameters to prevent exploding gradients during training
